⭐ 1/5 — Extremely disappointing breakfast buffet

I normally never write bad reviews for restaurants, but my experience at Itihas today was bad enough that I genuinely felt people should know before spending their money here.

I went for the non-veg breakfast buffet, which was around ₹300. The price itself isn’t the issue — you can charge ₹300, ₹600, or even ₹800, but the quality of the food should at least be acceptable.

The fish had a very unpleasant smell, and the chicken was honestly one of the worst-tasting chicken dishes I’ve ever had. The overall quality of the food was extremely disappointing. There was dosa, set dosa and a few other items, but the buffet had very little variety, and there wasn’t even a basic juice option.

Calling this a breakfast buffet feels misleading when the selection is so limited and the food quality is this poor. It’s not about the price; it’s about value and basic food quality.

If the restaurant wants to charge more, that’s completely fine — make it ₹600 or ₹800, but serve food that is actually worth eating.

Unfortunately, based on today’s experience, I won’t be visiting Itihas again, and I would strongly suggest checking the buffet before committing to it.
